ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon FileSystem Load Attempt By Format.com
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of format.com with an uncommon filesystem selection that could indicate a defense evasion activity in which "format.com" is used to load malicious DLL files or other programs.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\format\\\.com$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/fs\\:.*")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/fs\\:exFAT.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/fs\\:FAT.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/fs\\:NTFS.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/fs\\:ReFS.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/fs\\:UDF.*")))
